scenes.stage_direction: Victor's commands meet increasingly specific questions he cannot answer. His uncertainty must not be played as proof Ethan is safe.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: The appointment belongs to the last evening before Adrian died.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: I thought the old questions could wait until Ethan came home.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: This one may be part of bringing him home. Did Adrian keep a record of the meeting?

metadata.evidence_summary: The kidnapping and his death share a documented connection.
